author: mislav_marohnic
title: RFC 001: Secure OAuth Token Storage using Native OS Keyrings
body:
Status: accepted

Context:
Storing GitHub OAuth tokens in plaintext YAML config files (~/.config/gh/hosts.yml) leaves developer credentials vulnerable to unauthorized local processes.

Decision:
Integrate native OS keychain/keyring providers (macOS Keychain, Windows Credential Manager, Linux SecretService) as default secure token storage.

Consequences:
- Zero plaintext credential storage on disk.
- Fallback to encrypted config file if keyring daemon is unavailable.

author: vilmibm
title: Issue #412: Plaintext tokens exposed in process environment variables and config files
body: Security audit noted that gh auth login stores tokens in world-readable ~/.config/gh/config.yml. Keyring integration requested.

author: samcoe
title: PR #518: Add zalando/go-keyring provider for auth token persistence (Closes #412)
body: Implements RFC 001. Migrates token storage to native OS keychain with graceful fallback to file store.

author: mislav_marohnic
title: Review on PR #518: Reject custom symmetric encryption key on disk
body: Custom symmetric key encryption stored next to the ciphertext offers zero additional security. We must use OS-level protected credentials.

author: ampinsk
title: RFC 003: Subprocess Extension Execution Model with Scoped Token Environment
body:
Status: accepted

Context:
Executing third-party gh extensions inside the main process runtime risks memory contamination and uncontrolled privilege escalation.

Decision:
Execute extensions as isolated external child subprocesses communicating via standard input/output with stripped environment variables.

Consequences:
- Protects host CLI process memory.
- Prevents extension crashes from terminating main CLI session.

author: samcoe
title: RFC 002: GraphQL Query Batching and Fragment Reuse for Repositories
body:
Status: accepted

Context:
Listing 30 pull requests previously executed 30 separate REST requests to fetch review statuses, causing high latency and rate limit depletion.

Decision:
Consolidate GitHub API access through GraphQL queries using reusable fragments and connection paging.

Consequences:
- Latency reduced from 3.2s to 420ms for PR lists.
- Single API call quota unit consumed per page.

author: vilmibm
title: Issue #480: N+1 REST API roundtrips during repo list with pull requests
body: Running gh pr list on repositories with extensive checks resulted in secondary API queries per line item exceeding the 5,000 req/hr rate limit.

author: samcoe
title: PR #592: Batch repository and issue queries using GraphQL fragments (Closes #480)
body: Implements RFC 002. Replaces REST loops with single paginated GraphQL queries fetching comments, reviews, and status rollups in one payload.

author: ampinsk
title: Issue #550: Extension crash corrupts parent terminal state and escapes PATH
body: Extensions invoking raw exec commands leaked file descriptors and left raw terminal mode active on fatal signal crashes.

author: mislav_marohnic
title: PR #670: Fork-exec child subprocess isolation with restricted inherited env for extensions (Closes #550)
body: Implements RFC 003. Child process manager cleans up terminal modes on SIGINT/SIGTERM and restricts PATH lookup to extension directory.

author: samcoe
title: Review on PR #670: Reject executing third-party extensions via in-process Go plugins
body: Go dynamic plugin loading requires exact compiler and dependency ABI matches and allows arbitrary memory access. External subprocess isolation is non-negotiable.

author: vilmibm
title: RFC 004: Terminal Color and Hyperlink Detection via termenv
body:
Status: accepted

Context:
Hardcoded ANSI escape codes corrupted tabular output when piping to external commands (grep, awk, jq) or running in CI logs.

Decision:
Use termenv library to inspect terminal color profile, automatically stripping styling when stdout is not a TTY or NO_COLOR is set.

Consequences:
- Clean machine-readable output in scripts.
- Rich interactive color and OSC 8 hyperlinks in supported terminal emulators.

author: mislav_marohnic
title: Issue #620: Broken ANSI escape sequences when piping gh output to jq and grep
body: Users scripting gh pr list | jq . experienced JSON syntax errors because color escape sequences were embedded inside fields.

author: vilmibm
title: PR #735: Auto-detect TTY and disable ANSI formatting in non-interactive pipelines (Closes #620)
body: Implements RFC 004. Replaces hardcoded escape codes with IOStreams ColorEnabled check and respects CLICOLOR / NO_COLOR standard env vars.

author: samcoe
title: RFC 005: Git Credential Helper Protocol Provider
body:
Status: accepted

Context:
Users running git clone after authenticating via gh auth login were prompted again by Git for their username and password.

Decision:
Implement gh auth git-credential command implementing the standard Git credential helper protocol responding to get, store, and erase.

Consequences:
- Transparent authentication for all git operations.
- Reuses secure OAuth token stored in native keychain.

author: samcoe
title: PR #810: Implementation of gh auth git-credential helper protocol
body: Implements RFC 005. Configures git credential helper entry in global .gitconfig during gh auth login setup.

author: mislav_marohnic
title: Review on PR #810: Reject global auth token in HTTP GET query string
body: Passing tokens in URL query parameters exposes them in web server access logs and proxy history. All authentication must strictly use Authorization: Bearer HTTP header.

author: ampinsk
title: Issue #780: Browser open failure in headless SSH and cloud container environments
body: Running gh auth login on remote headless EC2 instances hung indefinitely attempting to open xdg-open desktop browser.

author: samcoe
title: PR #920: OAuth Device Code flow fallback for headless SSH sessions (Closes #780)
body: Detects lack of display server or SSH session and displays 8-digit one-time device code with github.com/login/device URL for secondary device authentication.
